integrity: An unrestricted combinatorial proof and independent-definition finite tests are included. No independent mathematical audit has been undertaken.
scientific_limitations: Requires both shores of size at least three and deleted edges to be disjoint.
The weight-four scalar optimum is prior-implied; only complete weight enumeration and affine edge-deletion response are assessed.
An unindexed equivalent result could predate this work.
title: Affine hop-total-Roman weight polynomials under matching deletion from complete bipartite graphs
